```{r}
# ---- Packages ----
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)
#library(rlang)

# Optional for rank-biserial effect size (Wilcoxon)
has_rstatix <- requireNamespace("rstatix", quietly = TRUE)

# ---- Helper: APA p-value formatting ----
fmt_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("p = NA")
  if (p < .001) "p < .001" else sprintf("p = %.3f", p)
}

# ---- Read data ----
# UPDATE the file path to your workbook
file <- "/Users/avantika/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/BDL/Member_Folders/Avantika/000_Projects/P_004_ELP_DLD/DataAnalysis/matched_pairs_phon_sem.xlsx"
sheet <- "Matched_phon"

dat <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file, sheet = sheet, detectDates = FALSE)

# ---- Coerce numeric where needed ----
num_cols <- c("DLD_kbit","TYP_kbit","DLD_age","TYP_age","DLD_edu","TYP_edu","DLD_CELF","TYP_CELF")
for (cc in num_cols) {
  if (!cc %in% names(dat)) stop(paste("Column missing:", cc))
  dat[[cc]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dat[[cc]]))
}

# ---- Split vectors ----
DLD_kbit <- dat$DLD_kbit
TYP_kbit <- dat$TYP_kbit
DLD_age  <- dat$DLD_age
TYP_age  <- dat$TYP_age
DLD_celf <- dat$DLD_CELF
TYP_celf <- dat$TYP_CELF
DLD_edu  <- dat$DLD_edu
TYP_edu  <- dat$TYP_edu
DLD_elision <- dat$`CTOPP-2_EL_ScS_DLD` 
TYP_elision <- dat$`CTOPP-2_EL_ScS_TYP`
DLD_WC <- dat$CELF_WC_ScS_DLD
TYP_WC <- dat$CELF_WC_ScS_TYP


# Keep only non-missing pairs for education
keep_edu <- is.finite(DLD_edu) & is.finite(TYP_edu)

# ---- Descriptives ----
desc <- list(
  kbit = list(
    n_DLD = sum(is.finite(DLD_kbit)),
    n_TYP = sum(is.finite(TYP_kbit)),
    m_DLD = mean(DLD_kbit, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_DLD = sd(DLD_kbit, na.rm = TRUE),
    m_TYP = mean(TYP_kbit, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_TYP = sd(TYP_kbit, na.rm = TRUE),
    r_DLD_min = min(DLD_kbit, na.rm = TRUE),
    r_DLD_max = max(DLD_kbit, na.rm = TRUE),
     r_TYP_min = min(DLD_kbit, na.rm = TRUE),
    r_TYP_max = max(DLD_kbit, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  age = list(
    n_DLD = sum(is.finite(DLD_age)),
    n_TYP = sum(is.finite(TYP_age)),
    m_DLD = mean(DLD_age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_DLD = sd(DLD_age, na.rm = TRUE),
    m_TYP = mean(TYP_age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_TYP = sd(TYP_age, na.rm = TRUE),
     r_DLD_min = min(DLD_age, na.rm = TRUE),
    r_DLD_max = max(DLD_age, na.rm = TRUE),
     r_TYP_min = min(DLD_age, na.rm = TRUE),
    r_TYP_max = max(DLD_age, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  celf = list(
    n_DLD = sum(is.finite(DLD_celf)),
    n_TYP = sum(is.finite(TYP_celf)),
    m_DLD = mean(DLD_celf, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_DLD = sd(DLD_celf, na.rm = TRUE),
    m_TYP = mean(TYP_celf, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_TYP = sd(TYP_celf, na.rm = TRUE),
   r_DLD_min = min(DLD_celf, na.rm = TRUE),
    r_DLD_max = max(DLD_celf, na.rm = TRUE),
     r_TYP_min = min(TYP_celf, na.rm = TRUE),
    r_TYP_max = max(TYP_celf, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  edu = list(
    n_pairs = sum(keep_edu),
    med_DLD = if (any(keep_edu)) median(DLD_edu[keep_edu], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    med_TYP = if (any(keep_edu)) median(TYP_edu[keep_edu], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    iqr_DLD = if (any(keep_edu)) IQR(DLD_edu[keep_edu], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    iqr_TYP = if (any(keep_edu)) IQR(TYP_edu[keep_edu], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    r_DLD_min = min(DLD_edu, na.rm = TRUE),
    r_DLD_max = max(DLD_edu, na.rm = TRUE),
     r_TYP_min = min(DLD_edu, na.rm = TRUE),
    r_TYP_max = max(DLD_edu, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
 elsion = list(
    n_DLD = sum(is.finite(DLD_elision)),
    n_TYP = sum(is.finite(TYP_elision)),
    m_DLD = mean(DLD_elision, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_DLD = sd(DLD_elision, na.rm = TRUE),
    m_TYP = mean(TYP_elision, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_TYP = sd(TYP_elision, na.rm = TRUE),
   r_DLD_min = min(DLD_elision, na.rm = TRUE),
    r_DLD_max = max(DLD_elision, na.rm = TRUE),
     r_TYP_min = min(TYP_elision, na.rm = TRUE),
    r_TYP_max = max(TYP_elision, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  WC = list(
    n_DLD = sum(is.finite(DLD_WC)),
    n_TYP = sum(is.finite(TYP_WC)),
    m_DLD = mean(DLD_WC, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_DLD = sd(DLD_WC, na.rm = TRUE),
    m_TYP = mean(TYP_WC, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_TYP = sd(TYP_WC, na.rm = TRUE),
   r_DLD_min = min(DLD_WC, na.rm = TRUE),
    r_DLD_max = max(DLD_WC, na.rm = TRUE),
     r_TYP_min = min(TYP_WC, na.rm = TRUE),
    r_TYP_max = max(TYP_WC, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
 
)

# ---- Tests ----
# Welch two-sample t-tests
tt_kbit <- tryCatch(t.test(DLD_kbit, TYP_kbit, paired = FALSE, var.equal = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
tt_age  <- tryCatch(t.test(DLD_age,  TYP_age,  paired = FALSE, var.equal = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
tt_celf <- tryCatch(t.test(DLD_celf, TYP_celf, paired = FALSE, var.equal = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
tt_EL <- tryCatch(t.test(DLD_elision, TYP_elision, paired = FALSE, var.equal = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
tt_WC <- tryCatch(t.test(DLD_WC, TYP_WC, paired = FALSE, var.equal = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)

# Wilcoxon rank-sum test (education)
wx_edu <- if (sum(keep_edu) > 1) suppressWarnings(
  wilcox.test(DLD_edu[keep_edu], TYP_edu[keep_edu], paired = FALSE, exact = FALSE)
) else NULL

# Optional: rank-biserial effect size for education
eff_edu <- NULL
if (has_rstatix && sum(keep_edu) > 1) {
  df_edu <- data.frame(
    group = factor(c(rep("DLD", sum(keep_edu)), rep("TYP", sum(keep_edu))), levels = c("DLD","TYP")),
    value = c(DLD_edu[keep_edu], TYP_edu[keep_edu])
  )
  eff_edu <- rstatix::wilcox_effsize(df_edu, value ~ group, paired = FALSE, ci = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95)
}
```
